description: Start a quote. Required: exactly one of lead_id, account_id or contact_id. Recipient and address are filled from that record; the price list's standard lines are proposed with quantity 1 for a human to correct. Optional: title, valid_days (default 30), currency (default: CHF for a Swiss recipient, else EUR), country (ISO code; default from the record, else the seller's), language (de|en), tax_note, address, intro, asbest_project_id, and lines to give the positions outright: [{name, description?, unit?, quantity, unit_price, vat_rate?, discount_percent?}]. unit_price is in MAIN units of the currency — 100 means 100,00 €, NOT 1,00 € — or give unit_price_minor in cents. A line without vat_rate gets the recipient's default: 19 % for a German recipient of a German seller, 8.1 % in Switzerland, 0 % with reverse charge (EU business with VAT id) or for export. Numbers, date and tax text follow the recipient's country. Nothing is sent, and no prices are invented — an empty price list produces a quote with no positions and says so.

country.description: ISO code of the recipient's country, e.g. DE, AT, CH.

intro.description: Introductory text printed above the positions

language.description: de or en. Default from the country.

lines.description: Quote positions: name, quantity, unit_price (main units) and optional fields

items.description: unit_price in MAIN units (100 = 100,00), or unit_price_minor in cents.

tax_note.description: Overrides the derived tax note (reverse charge, export).

valid_days.description: Days the quote stays valid; default 30

name: draft_offer
